provenance.lean: Fw.Parts.PeopleCarouselCrop split_keeps_layout_wk, split_keeps_layout_cr, wk_crop_all_comp, wk_crop_pieces, cr_crop_zero, wk_layout, cr_orig_layout, wk_comp_trade, cr_comp_trade, leaver_box_differs, leaver_region, shift_eq_translate, follower_within_one, layer_budget
provenance.limit: look change (L, user look review): the leaver keeps its 32 px box and fades and scales under the followers, so its collapse and border-width shrink are gone (the differing region is the 32 px leaver slot); followers move by the compositor translate, within one device pixel of the layout position (LayoutUnit rounding not modelled). No clip-path is animated: a clip-path effect ticks on main in WebKit (wkThread) and paints in Chromium, so the crop is the container's existing overflow clip. Six compositor effects against one (a trade on the comp stage) and five animated layers (about 0.18 MB at dpr 3) for 220 ms of every 1.02 s.
